answer_1.quote: In this work we take a step towards these goals by considering grounded dialogue involving open-ended discussion of a given image, a setting that is naturally fun for humans, and study neural conversational models for task.

answer_2.quote: We measure recall at 1 and 5 (R@1/100 and R@5/100) retrieval metrics ... For the generative models we report the ROUGE-L metric.

answer_4.quote: we have a separate set of human evaluators look at the provided conversation turns, and ask them to compare two possible utterances for the next turn of conversation, given the image, dialogue history and relevant style ... to choose the 'more engaging' of the two possible utterances
answer_4.guideline: ask them to compare two possible utterances and choose the more engaging one
